question: Vyjayanthi Kashi is an exponent of which Indian classical dance form?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kuchipudi**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Vyjayanthi Kashi is an exponent of Kuchipudi, **an Indian classical dance form**
 
• Vyjayanthi Kashi** is also the artistic director of the Shambhavi School of Dance in Bangalore, **which **she established in 199**3.
 
• She **has received several awards for her work, including the Sangeet Natak Akademi Award in 2009 and the Nritya Choodamani title in 2018. **
 
• Vyjayanthi Kashi comes from a family of performing artists
 
• **Her grandfather, Dr. Gubbi Veeranna, was a well-known theater director and contributor to Kannada theater.**
